title: ONE GODDESS
sub: In Nha Trang, two peoples honor the same goddess, under two different names.
say: In Nha Trang, two peoples honor the same goddess, under two different names.

title: PO NAGAR
sub: The towers of Po Nagar were built by the Cham, in their old region of Kauthara.
say: The towers of Poh Nah-gar were built by the Chahm, in their old region of Kow-tah-rah.

title: TWO NAMES
sub: Cham worshippers honor the goddess Po Ina Nagar. Vietnamese pilgrims honor her too, as Thiên Y A Na, in the same towers.
say: Chahm worshippers honor the goddess Poh Ee-nah Nah-gar. Vietnamese pilgrims honor her too, as Tee-en Ee Ah Nah, in the same towers.

title: SHARED TOWERS
sub: Their practices are different, but they overlap.
say: Their practices are different, but they overlap.

title: STILL HERE
sub: Kauthara passed to the Nguyễn lords in 1653. The kingdom ended. Its people, its gods and its towers did not.
say: Kow-tah-rah passed to the Nwin lords in sixteen fifty-three. The kingdom ended. Its people, its gods and its towers did not.

title: HOW DID IT END?
sub: So how did the kingdom that built these towers come to an end?
say: So how did the kingdom that built these towers come to an end?
